marketing_description: The Milwaukee® M18 Fuel™ 7-1/4 in Circular Saw Kit (2834-21HD) features a POWERSTATE™ Brushless Motor that operates at speeds up to 6,000 RPM with variable speed trigger control. Designed with a magnesium housing and a top rubber handle, this 18 V tool delivers a 2-5/8 in cutting depth and an adjustable bevel range of 0 to 52 degrees. The kit comes equipped with a 12 Ah M18™ REDLITHIUM™ FORGE™ HD12.0 battery, a thin kerf steel blade, REDLINK PLUS Intelligence, and ONE-KEY digital tool management.
